comments.body: This excludes successfully executed tasks that `DiscardOldestPolicy` initially rejects and then resubmits. With one running task and a full one-slot queue, a third submission invokes the handler, drops the queued task, and re-enqueues the third task. After draining, `ThreadPoolExecutor.getCompletedTaskCount()` is 2, but this exclusion implies 1. The rejection definition below explicitly counts that initial handler invocation, so a task can legitimately contribute to both counters. Limit the exclusion to tasks that never begin processing on the executor, so retried tasks that do execute still count as completed ([JDK policy semantics](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/util/concurrent/ThreadPoolExecutor.DiscardOldestPolicy.html); [semantic ambiguity guidance](/docs/general/metrics.md#general-guidelines)).
